chapter: Willie Lynch, the Blue Rhythm Band and Teddy Hill
title: Blanchard and Bill Dillard working out at the Y
summary: Blanchard, once small and sickly, built himself up at the Y; Dillard and Benny James were strong; Blanchard later moved to Florida.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Now, you mentioned that Blanchard and Dillard both used to work out at the Y.
Yeah, they were what you call them...?
Yeah, well, that's what it was...

Because Blanchard in his younger days, he was not too big a person. Do you know what I mean? He was the sickly type of person. Young and small and sickly. And he built himself up, heh-heh, miraculously. I mean, he... Oh, you'd see him in his clothes, you wouldn't think anything about him. You know, "I could whip him with one

hand tied behind" -- one of them things. But don't let nobody touch him. You talk about a body; well, I mean, he had it. And he was tough... He really got a lot of good out of the Y, from that exercise and stuff, whatever they were doing he got a lot out of it. And he talked to me and told me, hey, I should come around to the Y sometimes and work out, you know. I said, 'Yeah, I'll do that.' It was all I could do to work out at that Savoy.
I understand Benny James also was a very quiet, nice fellow, but also very strong.

Well, Benny was just a strong person. I don't think he was doing any exercise. He was just a strong person. Yeah, Benny James, he didn't bother nobody. But of course, you never know what a person does. You know, he was built very strong. But he looked just like I look now. I mean, he looked like nothin'. Benny was nice and quiet. He didn't bother nobody.

Well, Dillard, I mean, he exercised. He showed it. You know what I mean? Those big arms and big legs. He looked like a Greek goddess (sic). He looked like one of them weightlifters and things -- you know what I mean? He had the body to show it, too.
Yeah, Blanchard figured...he taken his family and went down to Florida. I don't know what year that was, but...
But he has a son, you say...

His son is a concert pianist right now. I don't know where he's playing, because I don't keep up with Classical music. But Blanchard, I don't know if he ever come back to New York or not. I never heard nobody say anything about him.
